sub_graphs.title: EVM Jump Instruction State Transitions
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transitions when EVM executes JUMP and JUMPI instructions, including validation of jump destinations

nodes.label: Program Counter at JUMP Opcode
nodes.description: EVM state when the program counter points to a JUMP (0x56) or JUMPI (0x57) instruction

nodes.label: Pop Jump Destination from Stack
nodes.description: Pop the jump destination address from the EVM stack

nodes.label: Pop Jump Condition from Stack
nodes.description: For JUMPI, pop the condition value from the stack after popping destination

nodes.label: Evaluate Jump Condition
nodes.description: Check if the condition value is non-zero (true) or zero (false)

nodes.label: Jump Condition Evaluated True
nodes.description: The JUMPI condition was non-zero, jump will be attempted

nodes.label: Jump Condition Evaluated False
nodes.description: The JUMPI condition was zero, execution continues sequentially

nodes.label: Validate Jump Destination
nodes.description: Check if destination exists in evm.valid_jump_destinations set

nodes.label: Jump Destination Valid
nodes.description: The destination address is in the valid_jump_destinations set

nodes.label: Jump Destination Invalid
nodes.description: The destination address is NOT in valid_jump_destinations

nodes.label: Set Program Counter to Destination
nodes.description: Update evm.pc to the validated jump destination address

nodes.label: Program Counter Updated
nodes.description: EVM program counter now points to the jump destination

nodes.label: Raise InvalidJumpDestError
nodes.description: Raise an exception because the jump destination is invalid

nodes.label: Execution Halted - Invalid Jump
nodes.description: EVM execution halted due to InvalidJumpDestError

nodes.label: Increment Program Counter
nodes.description: Increment PC by 1 to continue sequential execution

external_entities.name: EVM Bytecode
external_entities.description: The contract bytecode being executed, which contains the jump instructions and determines valid_jump_destinations

sub_graphs.title: Control Flow Instructions Gas Costs
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas consumption for control flow opcodes in the EVM

nodes.label: Gas Available for Execution
nodes.description: Current amount of gas remaining in the EVM execution context

nodes.label: Charge GAS_BASE
nodes.description: Deduct GAS_BASE cost for PC and GAS opcodes

nodes.label: Charge GAS_MID
nodes.description: Deduct GAS_MID cost for JUMP opcode

nodes.label: Charge GAS_HIGH
nodes.description: Deduct GAS_HIGH cost for JUMPI opcode

nodes.label: Charge GAS_JUMPDEST
nodes.description: Deduct GAS_JUMPDEST cost for JUMPDEST opcode

nodes.label: Gas Successfully Deducted
nodes.description: Gas cost charged and sufficient gas remains

nodes.label: Out of Gas
nodes.description: Insufficient gas to execute the instruction

sub_graphs.title: EVM STOP Instruction Execution
sub_graphs.description: Models how the STOP opcode halts EVM execution gracefully

nodes.label: EVM Running
nodes.description: EVM is actively executing bytecode with evm.running = True

nodes.label: Program Counter at STOP
nodes.description: PC points to STOP opcode (0x00)

nodes.label: Execute STOP Opcode
nodes.description: Process the STOP instruction

nodes.label: Set Running Flag False
nodes.description: Set evm.running = False to halt execution

nodes.label: EVM Execution Halted
nodes.description: EVM has stopped executing, evm.running = False

ambiguities.text: The specification does not explicitly define what happens to the gas when InvalidJumpDestError is raised
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume all gas is consumed on InvalidJumpDestError as is standard for exceptional halts. This follows EVM convention.

ambiguities.text: The relationship between valid_jump_destinations and JUMPDEST markers during bytecode analysis is not specified in this file
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume valid_jump_destinations is pre-computed during contract deployment/initialization by scanning bytecode for JUMPDEST opcodes.

implicit_assumptions.description: The valid_jump_destinations set is correctly computed and immutable during execution
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If valid_jump_destinations can be modified during execution, an attacker could potentially redirect execution flow to arbitrary locations in bytecode.

implicit_assumptions.description: Stack values popped for jump destinations are treated as unsigned 256-bit integers without overflow checks
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If stack values are misinterpreted, jumps could target unintended addresses.

implicit_assumptions.description: Gas costs (GAS_BASE, GAS_MID, GAS_HIGH, GAS_JUMPDEST) are defined elsewhere and are consistent across implementations
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Inconsistent gas costs could lead to consensus failures or gas estimation errors.
